issues.problem: Final merge depends on a hard-coded total_steps=30000 rather than the runtime's step count; a group-training run with --steps between 1000 and 28999 saves a checkpoint with ~40% of the Gaussians still cached (never evaluated).
issues.evidence: group_step merges only if step >= config total_steps; runtime does not pass steps to the density.
issues.fix: Harmless for the 30k benchmark; optionally raise/warn in initialize when the cache is non-empty at checkpoint, or document that total_steps must equal --steps.

issues.problem: Two faithful-but-consequential interactions are undocumented: (a) opacity resets at 3000/6000/9000/12000 fall inside a grouping window, so only the 60% subset is reset and the cached 40% keep their opacity (and OPS then favours them at the next regroup); (b) every refine at a multiple of 500 (1500..14500) runs on one step of statistics because the merge just zeroed grad2d/count.
issues.evidence: Official: grouping before render of iter k, prune/densification_postfix zero accumulators, densify+reset at end of iter k on current (subset) model only. Port: regroup at after_backward(k-1), base refine/reset at after_backward(k) on params = subset. Same behaviour.
issues.fix: Add two lines to report.md so a gap analyst does not 'fix' them.

issues.problem: Retained-row moment check uses moments captured after the regroup, so an implementation that zeroed the sampled set's Adam moments at regroup (not official) would still pass; the opacity-reset/cache interplay is not probed.
issues.evidence: active_m is snapshotted after d.regroup + 4 Adam steps.
issues.fix: Compare optimizer state right after regroup with full_m[...][mask].

issues.problem: The -0.51 dB smoke gap is explained only by 'Gaussians sit out'; it is also the forced merge at the very last step with no re-adaptation window (the real schedule gives 1000 steps after I_O). Not a fidelity signal either way.
issues.evidence: smoke2k merges at step 2000, right after a regroup at 2000.

issues.problem: Host version can be narrowed: the official cache dict lacks new_tmp_radii, so it only runs on graphdeco 3DGS before the tmp_radii change (late 2024), whose densification_postfix zeroes xyz_gradient_accum/denom/max_radii2D — consistent with the port.

probe_assessment.why: Exact count + inclusion frequencies vs independent numpy reference; random (0.6/0.6) and with-replacement sampling fail.
Checks event iterations and the exact SH-frozen render steps (14500 only, 29000..30000); an off-by-one in regroup timing shifts the frozen window and fails.
Removing the regroup, keeping cached moments, or not zeroing accumulators fails; does not catch zeroing retained moments at regroup (minor).
Real gsplat loop: cached rows bit-identical across a merge, stats stay subset-indexed, regroup/final-merge events required.

fidelity_gaps_confirmed: Verified against official code: regroup keeps sampled rows' Adam moments and their xyz_gradient_accum/denom/max_radii2D (prune_points indexes them); at every regroup after the first, the preceding merge has already zeroed all accumulators (port identical).
Opacity reset touches only the under-training subset; cached Gaussians are not reset (official and port identical).
Densification only on the subset, with one-step statistics at refine steps that coincide with groupings (official and port identical).
SH-rest freeze lasts one iteration at 14500 (undone by the 14500 densify, official requires_grad_(True) rebuild) and 29000..30000 (port identical).
Regroup in after_backward(k-1) after the runtime optimizer step is equivalent to the official grouping before render(k); no gradient is lost.
Shared runtime gaps (white background, no max_radii2D screen-size prune, optimizer step before density, SH-degree/view sampling) affect baseline and method equally.

paper_results.json matches tab:supp_3dgs_MipNerf360 OPS 0~30K and 3DGS* rows (all 9 scenes PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS/size/time/PM) and Table 3 averages; time ratios garden 0.646, counter 0.820; size ratios 0.78/0.79.
No efficiency killer found: per regroup one cat + one index of N rows and one multinomial, every 500 steps; optimizers are updated in place, not rebuilt.
summary: Faithful port of the official plug-in. Removal/caching, merge semantics (zero appended moments, kept step, zeroed accumulators), OPS on activated opacity with int(0.6N) without replacement, schedule timing, SH-freeze windows and the subset-only opacity reset/densification all match the official code operator by operator. pytest 5/5 and ss-verify (CUDA) pass. Only documentation/probe-strength minors.
